direction.camera: Guide attention with typographic monument; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: make a small number of words the main visual subject; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with poster scale; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with graphic stop.
direction.lighting: flat poster fill; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: solid pigment and letterform edges; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around clear accent; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use typographic monument,poster scale,word contrast,bold geometry,clear accent,graphic stop as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
